comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
Not being able to move items on the ground around in the grid is expected, they aren’t owned by the grid, they are a read-only view in the grid until they’re moved to your inventory. When you add an item from your inventory to the grid, it is then “owned” by the grid until you close your inventory at which point it’s moved to the world as loose loot. This change in handling of ownership is required to be compatible with Fika

comments.body_html:
Dear DrakiaXYZ,

first of all, I want to thank you for the amazing work you have provided to this community - to us. I truly appreciate you putting in the effort and providing mods and tools that enhance our individual SPT experience.

For quite a while I have been playing survival shooters and apocalyptic looting games; DayZ being my most played one by far. (Back in the day where it was just run, loot and survive … and occasionally making friends along the way) Coming from such a background, I cannot tell you how great the feature you brought to Tarkov really is. Your implementation of the looting mechanic feels so intuitive and is one of the best QoL-Mods out there.

I know that you are probably weary of all those comments asking about an update; I really don’t want to be just another one like that. I’ve also read that the implementation had not been that easy and that it would require quite an overhaul in order to be functional.

Surely, I do not want to harass you - I just wanted to tell you that this is one of my all-time favourite mods of SPT. Your work here makes such a difference.

Even though, I might risk a ban, I hope you bring it back <3

It is truly a masterpiece.

Sincerely Meteorit
